task: Productize a Lattice-compatible Parallel Wave control surface for multi-story/worktree delivery planning.

Output shows Parallel Wave W-xxxx, mainline story starts first, independent supporting stories are parallel DEV candidates, dependent stories stay plan_only, shared hotspot conflicts are visible, and Authority says wave is scheduling guidance only with productionDone=false until verified server receipts exist.

Existing Lattice handoff/evidence commands are read-only, no-overwrite projections that preserve authorityChanged=false.
constraints: Do not treat a wave artifact, worktree, handoff, local JSON, or capability probe as production authority.
Do not replace Canonical Story v0; add collection-level Parallel Wave state that references stories.
Use Koala CLI/JSON surfaces and command policy/fact registry for any new command.
Keep the implementation scoped to Orchestrate/Koala CLI unless later tests prove Mac/Python changes are needed.
Every checklist item needs happy/edge/adversarial evidence before DONE.
